summary: Tested the new Monitor RPi feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 10/11 pytest cases passed; 1 skipped (cross-tenant 403 heartbeat cannot be exercised because only one gym exists with an api_token in this env). Frontend: super admin login, /admin/device-monitor renders device card with local IP (192.168.1.77), public IP (35.193.209.116), temp, CPU, RAM, disk, uptime, WiFi, QR readers, camera, last scan, software version; EN LINEA status visible with pulsing green dot. Command buttons work: open_entrada sends immediately with toast; reboot and restart_service open AlertDialog (data-testid command-confirm-dialog), cancel closes without sending, confirm sends and shows toast. Command history (data-testid device-command-history-{id}) updates with pending/delivered/executed rows. Heartbeat → pending command delivery → command-result flow fully functional. Pending test-side commands were drained via heartbeats so the real Pi will not execute them later.
critical_code_review_comments: device_management_routes._expire_old_commands is called inside the per-device loop in GET /devices/status; harmless now but with N devices this is O(N) writes per poll (every 10s). Consider a single update_many across all devices.

POST /devices/{id}/heartbeat and /command-result parse the request body manually (await request.json()) instead of using Pydantic models. Add schemas to get validation + 422 responses on malformed payloads.
GET /devices/status does one gyms.find_one per device (N+1 query). Batch with $in or $lookup for scalability.

DeviceMonitorCard.js: the Loader2 icon reuses ui.cls which contains 'animate-spin' — correct, but the sibling label text next to it strips 'animate-spin' with a .replace, which is a brittle string hack. Define separate classes for icon vs label.
Only the first X-Forwarded-For hop is used for public_ip; behind multiple proxies this may capture an internal IP. Documented ok for current infra.

seed_data_creation: No new devices created. All pending commands produced during testing (test_video, open_entrada, restart_service) were drained via heartbeat loop and marked executed/test-cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Monitor RPi feature is fully working. Cross-tenant 403 heartbeat check requires a second gym with api_token to test — currently skipped. If a 2nd gym exists later, re-run test_heartbeat_wrong_gym_token. Public IP captured via X-Forwarded-For comes out as the preview-proxy exit IP (e.g. 35.193.209.116) which is expected.
